snippet.title: Hex Harmony - Prerelease Gameplay
snippet.description:
Restore the balance between Nature and Human using futuristic technologies. Each island is a true puzzle. Build thoughtfully, observe interactions, and shape a durable world in a calm and accessible experience.

Wishlist now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4491420/Hex_Harmony/

Join the discord to become a playtester! https://discord.gg/JNU9SxjDDy

More links (play free demo) : https://linktr.ee/HexHarmony
